verses.1: Unto the end. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.2: I cried out to the Lord with my voice, to God with my voice, and he attended to me.
verses.3: In the days of my tribulation, I sought God, with my hands opposite him in the night, and I was not deceived. My soul refused to be consoled.
verses.4: I was mindful of God, and I was delighted, and I was distressed, and my spirit fell away.
verses.5: My eyes anticipated the vigils. I was disturbed, and I did not speak.
verses.6: I considered the days of antiquity, and I held the years of eternity in my mind.
verses.7: And I meditated in the night with my heart, and I was distressed, and I examined my spirit.
verses.8: So then, will God reject for eternity? Will he not continue to allow himself to show favor?
verses.9: Or, will he cut off his mercy in the end, from generation to generation?
verses.10: And would God ever forget to be merciful? Or, would he, in his wrath, restrict his mercies?
verses.11: And I said, “Now I have begun. This change is from the right hand of the Most High.”
verses.12: I was mindful of the works of the Lord. For I will be mindful from the beginning of your wonders,
verses.13: and I will meditate on all your works. And I will take part in your intentions.
verses.14: Your way, O God, is in what is holy. Which God is great like our God?
verses.15: You are the God who performs miracles. You have made your virtue known among the peoples.
verses.16: With your arm, you have redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and of Joseph.
verses.17: The waters saw you, O God, the waters saw you, and they were afraid, and the depths were stirred up.
verses.18: Great was the sound of the waters. The clouds uttered a voice. For your arrows also pass by.
verses.19: The voice of your thunder is like a wheel. Your flashes have illuminated the whole world. The earth has quaked and trembled.
verses.20: Your way is through the sea, and your paths are through many waters. And your traces will not be known.
verses.21: You have conducted your people like sheep, by the hand of Moses and Aaron. [ Psalm 77 ] (78)
